notes: Canonical units follow every paragraph of the selected complete electronic witness (Rio de Janeiro: Typographia Nacional, 1881, old orthography). Sections 1–162 are the address ‘Ao leitor’ (section 1), the dedication to the worm (section 2) and the 160 numbered chapters; each chapter begins with its numeral and title joined in one heading unit. The title page, list of the author’s other works, epigraph and the index are excluded. Typographic passages made of dots and shapes are single units whose spacing and line breaks are kept. Passage IDs are immutable and may not be reassigned.
